newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen weak on settlement day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen weak on settlement day.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to stay weak on Tuesday's settlement day on selling pressure following a fresh spate of sectarian and political violence in various cities across the country, dealers said.
"The recent killings in sectarian violence in Punjab (province) and unrest in Karachi will further dampen sentiment," dealer Dawar Hasan said.

On Monday, the Karachi index plunged below the 1,900-point mark due to what dealers described as a technical correction. The index ended 45.62 points, or 2.36 percent, down at 1,887.64. Losers outnumbered gainers 211 to 50.
Turnover rose to 81.92 million shares from 71.01 million in the previous session.
